name: P07 gap #2 — measure the boy at the real gameplay camera, and find what framing he actually needs

steps.note: the title is its own scene: walk out of it before asserting on the field
A. the meadow opening exactly as a player first sees it — the shipped camera, no overrides
B. the target the rig actually solves for (camera.js:139 frame.hero=20), against the bands the tests pin
C. walk 6 m with a REAL held key so the position solver is live, then measure again — is 20.0 rest-only?
D. can a child see his FACE? the point of DQV field framing is the expression. How many px tall is his head?

steps.eval: (()=>{const f=__DQ.cameraFrame();const ppu=f.heroPx/f.heroHeight;const r=0.228,diam=2*r;const headPx=diam*ppu;return JSON.stringify({pxPerUnit:+ppu.toFixed(1),headRadiusWorld:r,headDiameterWorld:+diam.toFixed(3),headAsPctOfBoy:+(100*diam/f.heroHeight).toFixed(1),headPx:Math.round(headPx),headPctOfFrame:+(100*headPx/f.h).toFixed(2),verdict:headPx>=28?'readable':(headPx>=18?'thin':'too small to read'),note:'chars.js:785 child head radius 0.228 -> diameter 0.456 of the 1.114-unit boy; DQV brows+eyes need ~28px to read'});})()

(()=>{const f=__DQ.cameraFrame();const ppu=f.heroPx/f.heroHeight;const headPx=2*0.228*ppu;const at=pct=>Math.round(headPx*pct/f.heroPct);return JSON.stringify({headPxNow:Math.round(headPx),headPxAt27:at(27),headPxAt32:at(32),heroPctNeededFor28pxHead:+(28*f.heroPct/headPx).toFixed(2),verdictAt20:headPx>=28?'readable':'too small to read',verdictAt27:at(27)>=28?'readable':'too small to read'});})()
